recentItems.title: IDF's War Vehicles Push Into Syria: UNDOF Watches As Troops Roll Into Villages, Set Up Checkpoints
recentItems.description:
IDF's War Vehicles Push Into Syria: UNDOF Watches As Troops Roll Into Villages, Set Up Checkpoints  

Israeli military forces have advanced through several villages in southern Syria's Daraa and Quneitra provinces, with footage capturing armoured vehicles moving through local communities and troops setting up checkpoints to stop and search passersby. The reported incursion unfolded as UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) vehicles were seen arriving after the Israeli patrol withdrew.
